title: Evidence source syntax and review freshness
behavior: HTTPS only; reject userinfo, nondefault ports, direct IPs, single-label hosts, malformed DNS labels and specified special-use suffixes; canonicalize URL and remove fragment.
Evidence review age is at most 30 days with at most five minutes future skew; stale or changed-policy reviews fail closed at approval and publication preparation.
Expose the earliest evidence expiry on a valid saved review; require renewed review after policy version changes; retain tenant, role and revision binding.
Source URLs, labels and owner override reasons remain excluded from audit details and publication snapshots.

limitations: This is syntactic evidence-reference validation and an operator-declared review-age gate, not automated source or factual verification. No URL fetch, DNS resolution, source quality assessment or claim truth verification occurs.
A public-looking domain can resolve privately, not exist, redirect or change. The gate does not certify reachability, availability, public routing or credibility.
Thirty days and five minutes of future clock skew are versioned application policy bounds, not legal or platform compliance guarantees.
Freshness is rechecked when saving review, approving content and preparing publication. This increment does not add claim freshness revalidation at later scheduled or live dispatch boundaries.
